notes: Every value is re-derived from a v3 artifact; nothing is hard-coded.
Every dataframe lookup is a boolean mask on named columns; a mask that does not select exactly one row raises.
The score-versus-rSIG matched-workload margin does not exist in any artifact and is not quotable, computed, or lifted from correspondence.
Every quoted AUROC is the integer card unless the accessor says continuous.
The nine denominators are never merged; each carries its own label.

score_card.variables must carry cc_anticoag; it lists 14 point variables and cc_anticoag is present
unstable_ring must not appear in table3_points.csv, score_card.variables, refit.points or refit.point_vars

table5d_matched_workload.csv Reference_instrument values = ['shock_index (instrument_only), same Stratum + Workload_target_label'] -- every value must be the shock-index string, so NO rSIG reference row exists and the rSIG matched-workload margin is UNQUOTABLE (no hand-differencing)
hc_route_counts 10985 + 5585 + 3013 = 19583 must equal the received_hc component 19583
7-rung flow ladder must close at every rung, across consecutive rungs, and agree across qc_manifest.cohort_flow / cohort_exclusions.json / table_consort.csv
composite 26479 must be <= 19583+4191+17156 and >= each component (a patient with two components is counted once)
refit.coefficients must round to table3_points.csv beta; mismatches = []
test N: score_card 79912, split_balance 79912, table4 79912; test events: split_balance 8826, table4 8826
nine-denominator ledger: all nine reproduce from the artifacts

642 percent-scale checks over 258 percent-rendered bundle entries: 125 exact numerator/denominator closures, 36 embedded-count brackets, 222 scale-mode checks, 1 mandatory-closure coverage checks, 258 range checks -- every printed percentage equals 100 * num / den to its own printed precision, and no *pct*-named source field is multiplied by 100 a second time
